# InChI converter provenance

`inchi-js.js` is from the npm `inchi-js@0.2.0` package (npm integrity `sha512-AnMUIQd6nEzOsFqzHHkI6DiQaHh3JdvoQVgWGI748sfomU930GBmbnz0DenEAdD+SlkDSNkqGnuvkHDCFFcFug==`). It embeds the official IUPAC InChI WASM and its bundled base64 decoder. The package and embedded InChI licenses are in LICENSE; this file must be included in distributed notices. Upstream source: https://github.com/cheminfo/inchi-js and https://github.com/IUPAC-InChI/InChI.

Modifications: disable glue fetch and XMLHttpRequest, limit decoded return strings, verify decompressed WASM SHA-256, change memory maximum from 32768 to 2048 64-KiB pages by replacing bytes `80 80 02` at offset 1257 with `80 90 00`, then verify output SHA-256. The original binary is identified by `bbeee9d49408290e37fef932d5c51baf7118349843236d3a282cf9269eacf91f`; capped binary is `aacc5bc90365de3f6c4e73df713c840b1a1f8a595975152a065284954be0d939`. Any mismatch fails closed. Padded ULEB128 encodings are allowed by the WebAssembly specification. Reproduce by unpacking the exact npm package and applying the documented source changes. Conversion happens offline in a disposable worker.

Both InChI and SMILES workers independently decode the fixed, build-time-inlined RDKit.js 2026.9.2 WASM without network or filesystem requests with a 128 MiB linear-memory cap. The loader verifies the exact original SHA-256 `caf7eb9f09733cfd3e1b038eb5e05f9eeafc05f58e5780561c583aba7e5d8fd4`, changes its defined memory limit at offset 9078 from bytes `80 80 04` (65536 pages) to `80 90 00` (2048 pages), verifies the resulting SHA-256 `12886a9a636994fd329df818c36c16bd5177a01f6081a0f1234d955ac70b59e9`, and supplies the module through Emscripten's `instantiateWasm` hook. This is a runtime-only change, with no changed third-party distributable. The standard RDKit third-party license notices remain applicable. The cap covers that module's linear memory, not all browser or JavaScript allocations.
